justification: Markdown handoff documents only (a research report, its notes and a context file) under a new handoff/ folder. No code, no data, nothing imported or served.

break_it.scenario: A reader treats a figure in the research notes as verified fact.
break_it.what_happens: A business decision rests on a vendor claim or a search-snippet number that the notes could not confirm.
break_it.how: The report marks evidence level per claim (vendor, snippet-level, single source) and CONTEXT.md lists what to verify before relying on it.
